question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**displacement**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage defines a landslip as the movement of rock, soil, or other materials down a slope.
 
• The word "displacement" refers to the shifting or movement of something from its original position, which accurately describes the movement of soil and rocks in a landslip.
 
• "**Displacement**" fits well in the sentence as it aligns with the context of landslides causing the downward movement of terrain materials.
 
• Other options ("**abduction**", "**altercation**", "**embezzlement**") do not fit the meaning of landslip.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Abduction (अपहरण): "Abduction" refers to forcibly taking someone away, which is unrelated to the movement of land or rocks.
 
• Altercation (विवाद): "Altercation" means a heated argument or disagreement, which does not fit the context of a landslip.
 
• Embezzlement (गबन): "Embezzlement" refers to the theft of funds, which is entirely irrelevant to the topic of landslides.
